label: TP
reason: User input flows directly into SQL query via string concatenation without proper sanitization. The doSomething() method assigns param to bar on cases 'A','C','D' (when switchTarget is 'A','C','D'), returning bar which is concatenated into sql query string. This enables SQL injection where attacker can inject arbitrary SQL syntax.

evidence.note: User param flows through doSomething() to bar variable
